Ir.bar_b_note: A neutral-stage turnaround of a creature whose reticulated tan-and-black hide goes sooty in faint end and lacks the coral gill accents of its board shows nothing of Palworld-class world or Valheim-class light, and the model itself sits below the owner's creature bar.

Ve.bar_b_note: Grandpa Elias reads instantly with a warm, appealing face, clear eyes and an earthy green-brown outfit that fits the Meadows palette, but he is more toon than the board's naturalistic portrait.

Bv.bar_b_note: A readable, scaled salamander silhouette, but the faint-end body goes near-black, the hide pattern reads as an even net print rather than authored markings, and there is no world or light to compare.

So.bar_b_note: A murky brown-black forest with no purple storm sky or lightning, flat magenta telegraph slabs, a tiny unreadable player creature and (A) the camera buried in canopy sank it far below Palworld's bright, readable boss fight.

Tj.bar_b_note: B's blue-grey translucent panel with large warm-gold ingredient text reads well, but keyboard glyphs instead of teal controller prompts and the dark, empty rainy world behind keep it short of a shipping game's HUD.

Fl.bar_b_note: B's Stormcapra matches the owner's style bar with real fleece, heavy horns and grounded faint poses, but A floats the faint body high off the stage, and a neutral stage cannot carry world or light parity.

Ba.bar_b_note: The swim frame and the scale against the trainer are good, but the sooty faint-end flanks and generic net-print hide keep the creature below the owner's bar, and there is no world to judge.

Xn.bar_b_note: The silhouette and scale read, but the dark flanks in faint end (darker on B) and the uniform reticulated hide without board accents sink it against the style bar.

top_changes.change: Stormwood fight (So): fade or collide the camera against trunks and canopy, lift exposure, add the fixed purple storm sky with white-violet lightning, put a rim light on both fighters, and swap the flat magenta telegraph slabs for physical effects (lightning arcs, web, debris) that hit something

Salamander creature (Ir/Bv/Ba/Xn): rework the hide toward the board's warm olive-umber with lighter, irregular spots, a pale belly that does not go black in faint end, and coral/pink gill frills; break up the even net print
Ground every faint pose on the stage (Fl A), and finish the craft panel on B's layout with controller-first teal button glyphs in one bottom hint bar
